content_units: For your priorities,   2 options clearly fit best overall  :   Air Canada   and   TAP Air Portugal  .
Lufthansa is disqualified   by the overnight layover, and   Air Transat is over budget  .
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
Air Canada   10h40 outbound   11h05 return   21h45 total   Non-stop   CAD 1,180
TAP Air Portugal   13h20 outbound   12h50 return   26h10 total   1 stop   CAD 1,095
Lufthansa   16h45 outbound   15h30 return   32h15 total   1 stop   CAD 980
Air Transat   11h10 outbound   11h25 return   22h35 total   Non-stop   CAD 1,215
-   Best match for shortest total travel time
- Carry-on included; checked bag costs extra
- Total travel time is only   21h45  , the shortest of all options
-   Cheapest valid option that meets all stated constraints
- Costs   CAD 85 less   than Air Canada, but adds   4h25   more total travel time
3) Lufthansa —   Low fare, but not a fit
- Fails your rule:   overnight 7h10 layover in Frankfurt
- Also much longer overall travel time
- Only worth considering if you relax the no-overnight-layover requirement
4) Air Transat —   Fast, but over budget
- Nearly as fast as Air Canada
- Fails your budget target at   CAD 1,215
- Only   CAD 35 over  , so it is a reasonable backup if fare rules or seat selection are better
It is the   best fit   because it satisfies every major constraint:
Choose TAP if your top goal is   saving money while still staying within all rules  :
- But costs you   4h25 more travel time total
-   Budget under CAD 1,200:   Air Canada, TAP, Lufthansa pass; Air Transat fails
-   At most 1 stop each way:   all 4 pass
-   No overnight layovers:   Air Canada, TAP, Air Transat pass; Lufthansa fails
-   Shortest total travel time:   Air Canada wins
2.   TAP Air Portugal   — best value under your rules
3.   Air Transat   — good flight profile, but over budget
4.   Lufthansa   — cheapest, but fails a major constraint
headings: 3) Lufthansa — Low fare, but not a fit
4) Air Transat — Fast, but over budget
